label: the crag crew
note: Races 4 and 5: the fourth rung of the race ladder, three locals who race out of Cragfall village on the far side of the planet, on the Crooked Mile: a tunnel through the far mountains, then a long run of switchbacks choked with rock (pillars and boulders moved there from round the planet). They only race you once you have beaten the salt crew (`after`). Top notch: two racers and a box truck, every one fully stacked (tier-two engine, thrusters and cannons), aces at the yoke, every piece of race gear, shooting from lap 1. Same shape as yard.json (read its note); the hangout frame's +x faces their start line.
